title: daphne odora var. kiusiana

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
